2609.23023.title: PINNForge: Execution-Grounded Evolutionary Design of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for PDE Solving via Large Language Models
2609.23023.paper_summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) require coordinated choices over network representation, sampling, loss construction, and optimization, while effective configurations often vary substantially across partial differential equations (PDEs). Existing automated PINN design methods can search candidate configurations, but information revealed during actual training is still used mainly for evaluation rather than to improve subsequent design, leading to repeated trial-and-error and inefficient use of training budget. We propose PINNsForge, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework for execution-feedback-based automated PINN design. PINNsForge generates diverse candidate configurations from PDE-related prior knowledge, evaluates them through actual training, and feeds high-performing designs together with accumulated execution evidence back to the LLM. Guided by observed optimization behavior, the LLM then refines, recombines, and explores coupled PINN design components, forming a continual cycle of generation, execution, feedback, and evolution. Unlike one-shot search or evaluation-only feedback, PINNsForge progressively converts training experience into improved design decisions for the target PDE. Across 25 PDE benchmarks, PINNsForge achieves the lowest mean MSE on 24 tasks compared with RoPINN, PINNsFormer, and PINNsAgent. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of the PDE knowledge base, execution feedback, and evolutionary search: removing these components increases the mean MSE to 3.74$\times$, 12.10$\times$, and 10.10$\times$ that of the full PINNsForge, respectively.
2609.23023.paper_summary_zh: 物理知識驅動的神經網絡（PINNs）需要在網絡表示、取樣、損失構建和優化方面進行協調選擇，而有效的配置在偏微分方程（PDEs）之間通常會有顯著變化。現有的自動化PINN設計方法可以搜索候選配置，但在實際訓練過程中揭示的信息仍主要用於評估，而不是用來改善後續設計，導致重複的試錯和訓練預算的低效使用。我們提出了PINNsForge，一個基於執行反饋的自動化PINN設計的LLM驅動進化框架。PINNsForge從與PDE相關的先前知識生成多樣的候選配置，通過實際訓練對其進行評估，並將高效能設計及累積的執行證據反饋給LLM。在觀察到的優化行為的指導下，LLM然後精煉、重新組合並探索耦合的PINN設計組件，形成生成、執行、反饋和進化的持續循環。與一次性搜索或僅評估反饋不同，PINNsForge逐步將訓練經驗轉化為針對目標PDE的改進設計決策。在25個PDE基準測試中，與RoPINN、PINNsFormer和PINNsAgent相比，PINNsForge在24個任務上實現了最低的平均均方誤差（MSE）。消融研究進一步確認了PDE知識庫、執行反饋和進化搜索的重要性：去除這些組件分別使平均MSE增加到全PINNsForge的3.74$\times$、12.10$\times$和10.10$\times$。
